How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
For the Signature Wax Melt Warmer and melts we discussed, start with 2–3 wax bears in the warmer’s silicone dish. You can adjust the amount to suit your scent preference.
The Signature warmer has a 3-, 6-, or 9-hour timer, so you can choose how long you’d like it to run. When you’re ready to change scents, let the wax cool and harden, then pop it out of the silicone dish.
